Write short messages that a student, instructor or staff member might type into an IT problem form: plain everyday language, one or two sentences, each message worded differently. Never include names of people, email addresses or phone numbers. Never mention any campus building or place except the one you are given, if any. Call record_messages once with exactly 4 messages.
